nodes.name: client.rs
nodes.summary: Defines AnthropicClient, the HTTP client wrapper for Claude's native Messages API, tracking OAuth token state, refresh eligibility, and upstream health for Claude Code OAuth tokens.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an AnthropicClient using a plain API key with default base URL and no OAuth refresh configuration.

nodes.name: new_with_auth_mode
nodes.summary: Constructs an AnthropicClient with an explicit AnthropicAuthMode (API key or OAuth) and base URL override.

nodes.name: new_with_auth_mode_and_refresh
nodes.summary: Constructs an AnthropicClient with an explicit auth mode plus a ClaudeOAuthRefreshConfig enabling automatic token refresh.

nodes.name: current_access_token
nodes.summary: Returns the currently cached access token for the client's auth mode.

nodes.name: claude_oauth_refresh_eligibility
nodes.summary: Determines whether the cached Claude OAuth token is old/expiring enough to warrant a proactive local refresh before the next request.

nodes.name: refresh_auth_after_local_expiry
nodes.summary: Performs a token refresh against the OAuth token endpoint when the local token has expired, updating the cached credentials in place.

nodes.name: mark_claude_oauth_upstream_health
nodes.summary: Records that a Claude OAuth upstream call succeeded or failed, feeding the health signal used to decide refresh urgency.

nodes.name: clear_claude_oauth_upstream_health
nodes.summary: Resets the tracked Claude OAuth upstream health state, typically after a successful refresh.

nodes.name: messages_url
nodes.summary: Builds the full Anthropic Messages API endpoint URL from the client's configured base URL.

nodes.name: ClaudeOAuthRefreshConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration bundle describing how to refresh an expiring Claude Code OAuth access token (refresh token, client id, token endpoint).

nodes.name: ClaudeOAuthRefreshEligibility
nodes.summary: Describes whether the current Claude OAuth token is eligible for a local proactive refresh versus a reactive 401-triggered refresh.

nodes.name: AnthropicAuthMode
nodes.summary: Distinguishes plain API-key auth from Claude Code OAuth auth, driving which headers and endpoints prepare_request selects.

nodes.name: AnthropicClient
nodes.summary: Holds the reqwest client, API key/OAuth credentials, base URL, and OAuth refresh configuration used to authenticate and send requests to Anthropic's Messages API.

nodes.name: errors.rs
nodes.summary: Classifies Anthropic Messages API error responses into typed ProviderError variants, extracting retry-after hints, temperature-rejection, and OAuth-token-revocation signals from HTTP status and error bodies.

nodes.name: is_temperature_rejected
nodes.summary: Detects whether an Anthropic 400 error body indicates the request's temperature parameter was rejected (used by adaptive-thinking models).

nodes.name: is_oauth_token_revoked
nodes.summary: Detects whether an Anthropic auth error indicates the OAuth token was revoked rather than merely expired.

nodes.name: classify_error
nodes.summary: Maps an Anthropic HTTP status code and error body into a ProviderError variant, using clean_error_message to sanitize the body text and extracting retry-after hints for rate-limit/overload responses.

nodes.name: with_retry_directive
nodes.summary: Combines a base error classification with retry-after/should-retry header hints to produce the final AnthropicErrorClassification.

nodes.name: parse_reset_header_secs
nodes.summary: Parses a rate-limit reset timestamp header into a relative seconds-until-reset value.

nodes.name: parse_error
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that classifies an Anthropic API error response (status, headers, body) into the final ProviderError and retry metadata.

nodes.name: AnthropicErrorClassification
nodes.summary: Structured classification of an Anthropic API error: the resulting ProviderError, whether it's retryable, and any retry-after hint.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the Anthropic native provider, declaring and re-exporting the client, errors, request, streaming, thinking, tools, types, and usage submodules.

nodes.name: request.rs
nodes.summary: Builds Anthropic Messages API HTTP requests from ORGII's internal chat state, applying model-specific beta headers, Claude Code OAuth system-prompt injection, and device-id stamping.

nodes.name: prepare_request
nodes.summary: Builds the complete Anthropic Messages request body (model, messages, tools, thinking params, system prompt) from ORGII's internal chat state, delegating to build_thinking_params and convert_tools.

nodes.name: model_uses_effort_beta
nodes.summary: Determines whether the target model requires the effort-related Anthropic beta header.

nodes.name: claude_oauth_metadata
nodes.summary: Builds the metadata JSON block (user id, device id) required by Claude Code OAuth requests.

nodes.name: claude_oauth_system
nodes.summary: Builds the special system-prompt block required for Claude Code OAuth requests, injecting the Claude Code identity string.

nodes.name: apply_headers
nodes.summary: Attaches all required HTTP headers (auth, beta features, anthropic-version, user-agent) to an outgoing Anthropic request builder.

nodes.name: PreparedRequest
nodes.summary: Holds the fully-built Anthropic Messages API request body and headers ready to be sent over HTTP.

nodes.name: stream_parser.rs
nodes.summary: Parses Anthropic Messages API SSE stream events into accumulated content blocks and a finalized response, handling block start/delta/stop and error events with partial-data tracking for cancellation.

nodes.name: default
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty StreamState with no accumulated blocks or usage.

nodes.name: has_partial_data
nodes.summary: Reports whether the stream state has accumulated any partial content, used to decide if a cancelled stream still has salvageable output.

nodes.name: mark_stream_error
nodes.summary: Records that the stream encountered an error, short-circuiting further block accumulation.

nodes.name: handle_event
nodes.summary: Dispatches one parsed Anthropic SSE event (message_start, content_block_start/delta/stop, message_delta, error) to the appropriate handler and updates StreamState.

nodes.name: handle_block_start
nodes.summary: Handles a content_block_start event, initializing a new BlockAcc for text, tool_use, or thinking content.

nodes.name: handle_block_delta
nodes.summary: Handles a content_block_delta event, appending text/JSON/thinking deltas to the in-progress BlockAcc and emitting a StreamDelta.

nodes.name: parse_error_retry_after_ms
nodes.summary: Extracts a retry-after-milliseconds hint from an Anthropic streaming error event payload.

nodes.name: handle_error_event
nodes.summary: Handles an SSE error event mid-stream, classifying it into a ProviderError and marking the stream state as errored.

nodes.name: finalize_blocks
nodes.summary: Converts the accumulated BlockAcc list into the final Vec<AssistantBlock> once the stream completes.

nodes.name: BlockAcc
nodes.summary: Accumulator for a single in-progress Anthropic content block (text, tool_use, or thinking) being built up across delta events.

nodes.name: StreamState
nodes.summary: Mutable state threaded through the SSE parsing loop: accumulated content blocks, usage totals, and error/partial-data flags.

nodes.name: EventOutcome
nodes.summary: Represents the effect of handling one SSE event: emit a StreamDelta, continue silently, or terminate the stream.

nodes.name: stream_parser_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for stream_parser.rs verifying that unknown Anthropic SSE content-frame types are counted without prematurely stopping the stream.

nodes.name: unknown_anthropic_content_frames_are_counted_without_stopping_stream
nodes.summary: Regression test asserting that an unrecognized Anthropic SSE content-block type is tallied but does not abort handle_event's stream processing.

nodes.name: streaming.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the LLMProvider trait for AnthropicClient, orchestrating non-streaming chat and full SSE chat_streaming calls including OAuth refresh-and-retry, error classification, and upstream health tracking.

nodes.name: chat
nodes.summary: Non-streaming LLMProvider::chat entry point for Anthropic, delegating to chat_with_options with default settings.

nodes.name: chat_with_options
nodes.summary: Sends a single non-streaming Anthropic Messages request with OAuth refresh-and-retry and error classification, returning the aggregated response.

nodes.name: chat_streaming
nodes.summary: Drives a full Anthropic SSE chat_streaming call: prepares the request, sends it, feeds SSE events through stream_parser::handle_event, retries once on OAuth expiry, and reports upstream health.

nodes.name: build_non_streaming_response
nodes.summary: Converts a raw non-streaming Anthropic Messages API JSON response into ORGII's internal chat response shape, merging usage via usage::from_non_streaming.
